findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rebalance_plan · Public sink: triage_email, get_stock_snapshot, screen_stocks · Destructive: retirement_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rebalance_plan · Public sink: triage_email, get_stock_snapshot, screen_stocks · Destructive: retirement_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
